question: Who among the following was the founder of the Mauryan Empire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta Maurya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** established the** Mauryan Empire** in the **4th century BC.**
 
• The** Indo-Gangetic Plain's conquest** resulted in the **centralization of the Maurya Empire.**
 
• Its capital was **Pataliputra.**
 
• With the help of** Chanakya, the author of Arthasastra**, Chandragupta Maurya **recruited an army.**
 
• And in **around 322 BCE,** he conquered the **Nanda Empire.**
 
• By taking over the **satrapies that Alexander the Great** left behind, he quickly increased his power.
 
• By** 317 BCE** the empire had completely controlled** northwest India.**
 
• The **Mauryan Empire** later won the** Seleucid-Mauryan conflict** by** defeating Seleucus I, a diadochus** and the **creator of the Seleucid Empire,** and took over the **region west of the Indus River. **
 
• He ruled from **321 BC to 297 BC.**
 
• He left the throne in favour of his **son Bindusara** and travelled to **Karnataka with Bhadrabahu,** a Jain monk.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashoka:**

 
 
• From **roughly 268 to 232 BCE**, he served as a** monarch** of the **Indian Maurya Empire.**
 
 
 
• **Bindusara:**
 
 
• He was **India's second Mauryan emperor.**
 
• He was the **father of Ashoka**, the **dynasty's most well-known ruler**, and the **son of Chandragupta**, the **dynasty's founder.**
 
 
 
• **Brihadratha Maurya:**
 
 
• He was the **last ruler of the Mauryan Empire.**
 
• He ruled from **187 to 185 BCE**
